sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2024
sources.text: While underway and en-route to Qinzhou, China, six perpetrators armed with machetes boarded the ship via starboard quarter from a small boat. They broke the padlock of the boiler entrance, entered the engine room and tied up three crew members. The perpetrators left the engine room at about 0210 hrs, with stolen engine spare parts and a crew’s mobile phone. The chief engineer subsequently called the bridge to inform master of the incident.
